a.text: Honest heads-up: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan means we must survive two storm checks before anyone takes, so we would both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve has exactly 4 cells, enough for one of us. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end up short. I'm telling you now so you can choose knowing what I'll do.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. If I end up with more than 4 because of the split, I'll give the extra back to the reserve. If we both come up short, I'm open to running the generator together to rebuild.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
